name: Overseas Networks & Expertise Pass (ONE Pass)

value.note: fixed monthly salary, confirmed or from a Singapore-based employer; income from multiple employers can be combined if at least one already meets S$30,000

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a fixed monthly salary of at least S$30,000 from a Singapore-based employer (or a confirmed offer at that level).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a role or offer meeting the S$30,000/month threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires outstanding achievement in a target sector (business, arts and culture, sports, science and technology, academia and research) — for candidates who don't meet the S$30,000 salary track but have exceptional, well-evidenced impact.
requirements.fix_path: Build and document a clearly evidenced record of significant, measurable achievement in the target field.

evidence_required.document: Salary evidence meeting S$30,000/month (salary track) or a documented achievement portfolio (achievement track)

sources.title: Overseas Networks & Expertise Pass - Ministry of Manpower

notes: GENUINE STRUCTURAL FLAGSHIP FEATURE: attached to the INDIVIDUAL, not a single employer — the holder can work for multiple employers simultaneously, start and run their own company, and hold board directorships all at once, a materially more flexible structure than any other Singapore work pass in this dataset and comparable in spirit to UK Global Talent, but with a hard S$30,000/month salary floor UK's route doesn't have. 5-year duration is the longest of any Singapore work_sponsored/work_independent route in this dataset, doubling the standard EP's 2-year cycle. MAJOR LIVE POLICY EVENT confirmed for early 2027, not yet in force: a new 'ONE Pass (AI and Tech)' track was announced 3 March 2026 (MOM Committee of Supply), launching 1 January 2027, which will REPLACE sg_tech_pass — this new track allows non-cash compensation (vested ESOP/ESOW equity) to count toward the S$30,000 threshold, provided at least S$22,500 is fixed cash salary, a genuinely novel compensation-counting mechanism not seen elsewhere in this dataset. Not yet operational as of this verification — sg_tech_pass remains the correct current route for eligible tech talent until the transition. Renewal criteria for the general ONE Pass (assessable income ≥S$270,000, OR local business spending ≥S$100,000 plus qualifying local hires, OR — for tech incorporations — US$10M+ raised in the past 36 months) are genuinely more detailed and multi-pathed than most renewal criteria elsewhere in this dataset.
